title: Odile and the Witness
author: Emrys Kavanagh
blurb: Zephyrine Brightwater, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
